scope: Cumulative accounting through release of the resumed 32-GPU holder at 17:31 UTC and the 17:35 provider-zero check. All 45 covered native GPU jobs are terminal. The newer 16-GPU routing holder is excluded and remains active. Child experiments inside holders are counted once with their enclosing allocation. This is an interim ledger; the optimization goal remains incomplete.
limitations: Observed intervals are incomplete and cannot serve as total actual allocation time.
Conservative nominal envelopes include queue wait and sparse provider release checks; they may substantially exceed actual use.
Native APIs omit prior attempts for some retried jobs; use retained Pod snapshots and full-job charges instead of summing only current attempts.
All provider snapshots have no more than nominal GPUs per job; unobserved replacement overlap is not separately timed.
Source snapshots are retained locally by filename/checksum; promote selected compact evidence before a final handoff.
The previous32-job accounting is reused without replacing its evidence or imputing missing old attempts.

The conservative figure is an estimate, not a formal upper bound or cloud bill.
